verdict.rationale: Asset checks can check whether an asset's data needs refreshing, and their results appear in the UI (dagster-docs-3, dagster-docs-37). Dagster+ alerts can notify on critical deployment events (dagster-docs-11, dagster-docs-32), and expected cadence can be expressed through cron schedules and on_cron automation conditions (dagster-docs-31, dagster-docs-38). However, the evidence never shows a dedicated freshness view per table or an alert that fires specifically when an asset misses its cadence, and alerting appears tied to the paid Dagster+ tier. Missing for 10: explicit freshness policy/SLA documentation, per-table freshness dashboard evidence, documented alerting on freshness violations or missed cadence, independent hands-on corroboration.
